plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'HVAC Technology map for 2026-2027' and the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. The inventoried program 'Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning Technology' is listed in the mapper under its short name 'HVAC Technology'; the program details state it is 'also known as Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration' and that the student 'will be awarded a HVAC Technology Associate of Science degree'. This plan transcribes the first-listed of the program's two 2026-2027 pathways, 'HVAC Technology / Associate of Science / 60-61.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no second-institution section. The second pathway for the same AS credential, 'to Degree' (also 60-61.5 units, 4 terms), is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 the same two pathways were listed in the opposite order, both at 60-61.5 units in 6 terms. The mapper also lists a separate HVAC Technology Certificate of Achievement program, a different credential, which was not transcribed. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and term totals as 16-17.5 / 16 / 15 / 13. The only ranged row is Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. The 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' slot is printed in both Terms 2 and 3 and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
